capability: OpenPoly literature water contact angle ML baseline: 173 polymers × 66 raw Bemis-Murcko scaffolds. Rigorously tests Ridge / Random Forest / HistGradientBoostingRegressor on Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, 512 bits) + log10(MW) features under scaffold-safe 80/20 held-out AND 66-fold LOSO-CV. Best model = RandomForest, holdout test MAE = 15.5463° (NULL 14.0893°, -10.3% relative), R² = -0.262. Hydrophobic classification (θ > 90° Cassie 1948 / Baier 1970 anti-biofouling reference): accuracy 0.711 on 38 test polymers. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority.
